reproduction_target: Nanopore amplicon genomics of six DENV-2-positive mosquito pools from Dar es Salaam: basecalling/demultiplexing (Guppy via MinKNOW), primer trimming and read QC (cutadapt, Filtlong), reference mapping (Minimap2/SAMtools), consensus + variant calling (iVar), MAFFT alignment and BEAST Bayesian phylogenies (genotype assignment, genotype-II whole-genome tree, E-gene tree) with Tracer/TreeAnnotator/FigTree, sample-consensus realignment and intra-host low-frequency variant calling/filtering/annotation, and R (ggplot2/tidyverse/ComplexUpset) visualization. Mosquito sampling, RNA extraction, cDNA/tiling multiplex PCR and Nanopore library preparation are wet-lab steps, out of computational-reproduction scope.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool-invocation from the Methods sections 'Genome assembly and consensus generation', 'Multiple sequence alignment and phylogenetic analysis' and 'Variant analysis'. SAMtools indexing is folded into the mapping steps it serves; BEAUti/TreeAnnotator/Tracer/FigTree are folded into the BEAST step they belong to. The E-gene phylogeny is kept as one step because the paper defers its methods to a Supplementary File that is not part of the stage-1 prose read. No code repository or code-availability statement exists anywhere in the paper; raw Nanopore reads are not deposited (only the six consensus genomes are on GenBank), so every read-level step is data-blocked at prose level. Wet-lab procedures counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: Live base-calling, real-time demultiplexing and quality filtering on GridION/MinKNOW: Guppy v6.4.2, high-accuracy mode, Q>10
Primer-sequence trimming from raw reads with cutadapt (no version, no command, primer set cited to Su et al. protocol)
Read quality filtering (quality >20) with Filtlong (no version stated)
Mapping of filtered reads to reference DENV-2 genome (GenBank MT982148.1) with Minimap2 v2.28-r1209, indexed with SAMtools (no version, no preset/flags given)
Consensus generation and variant calling with iVar v1.4.3; positions with coverage <10x masked as 'N'
Multiple-sequence alignment with MAFFT v7 ('default settings' for the genome set) of the six consensus genomes against DENV-2 genotype I-VI representative references

Genotype-assignment Bayesian phylogeny in BEAST v2.7.7 (BEAUti-generated XML; GTR + gamma 4 categories, relaxed log-normal clock mean 0.001, Bayesian Skyline prior, 100M MCMC generations, no tip dates, 10% burn-in, TreeAnnotator MCC, Tracer v1.7.2, FigTree v1.4.4)
Retrieval of 336 unique complete DENV-2 genotype-II genomes from GenBank using Biopython (custom retrieval script; no accession list, no query, no version)

Genotype-II whole-genome Bayesian phylogeny in BEAST (v2.7.7) with tip dates, GTR + gamma 4, relaxed log-normal clock (0.001 start), Bayesian Skyline prior, 100M MCMC, 10% burn-in MCC tree rooted on KM204118.1; Tracer v1.7.2 convergence check, FigTree v1.4.4 visualization
E-gene phylogeny of 1,132 unique DENV-2 genotype-II E gene sequences plus the six new sequences ('Detailed methods and the resulting phylogenetic tree are provided in the Supplementary File')
Realignment of each pool's reads to its own sample-specific consensus genome with Minimap2 v2.24; SAMtools v1.14 for conversion/sorting/indexing (no flags or preset given)

Intra-host variant calling with iVar variants (min base quality 20) plus filtering: PASS flag only, p<0.05, total depth >400, alt allele frequency >5%, alt base in {A,T,G,C}, indels/ambiguous and stop codons excluded; cutadapt primer trimming re-applied

Variant annotation: synonymous/nonsynonymous classification by reference-vs-alternate amino acid comparison and translation of codon positions into global polyprotein coordinates using gene annotations (custom code, unnamed; annotation source not stated)

Analysis and visualization of processed variant data in R with ggplot2, tidyverse and ComplexUpset (upset plot) plus a custom DENV-2 polyprotein genome schematic; no R version, no package versions, no script

headline.static_readiness: 0/14 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 2/14 (14%) RI under inference-inclusive reading - the two BEAST phylogeny steps (C7, C9), which run on public GenBank sequences and state model, clock, tree prior, chain length, burn-in and pinned BEAST/Tracer/FigTree versions. The remaining 12 steps cap at NI: nine read-level steps (C1-C5, C11-C14) are blocked because the raw Nanopore reads are not deposited anywhere (only the six consensus genomes PV834971-PV834976 are on GenBank), and C2/C3/C6/C8/C10/C13/C14 additionally lack version pins, custom scripts, or defer methods to a supplement. No code repository or code-availability statement exists, so there is no analysis artifact to read; capture_claim is exact_pins_partial (Guppy 6.4.2, Minimap2 2.28-r1209/2.24, SAMtools 1.14, iVar 1.4.3, BEAST 2.7.7, Tracer 1.7.2, FigTree 1.4.4 pinned; cutadapt, Filtlong, MAFFT (v7 major only), Biopython, R and all R packages unpinned) with no environment closure, so version stays <=1 everywhere and stage2 would yield no R-star gain.
headline.coverage: 14 computational steps assessed from Methods prose (Genome assembly / Phylogenetics / Variant analysis); 3 wet-lab steps counted in W (RNA extraction, cDNA synthesis + tiling multiplex PCR, Nanopore library prep and sequencing) but out of computational-reproduction scope. Full text retrieved from bioRxiv v1 full-text HTML (JATS source XML returned HTTP 403/1015). Data Availability Statement present; no Code Availability statement present. E-gene phylogeny methods are deferred to a Supplementary File not read at stage 1.

gaps.where: All read-level steps (C1-C5, C11-C14); Data Availability Statement
gaps.missing: Raw Nanopore sequencing data (FAST5/POD5 signal or basecalled FASTQ) for the six DENV-2-positive mosquito pools are not deposited. The Data Availability Statement lists only the six assembled consensus genomes (GenBank PV834971-PV834976) and permit information; there is no SRA/ENA study, BioProject, or run accession. Intermediate BAM/VCF and the filtered variant table underlying the 212 reported intra-host variants are also not deposited.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the raw reads under an SRA/ENA BioProject and link the run accessions per pool, plus the per-sample consensus references, primer BED/FASTA, and the filtered variant table used for the figures.

gaps.missing: No code repository (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Zenodo/figshare/OSF/Software Heritage) and no code-availability statement anywhere in the paper. No commands, workflow files, BEAST XML, Biopython retrieval script, variant-annotation script, or R plotting script are provided. Standard CLI steps are reconstructable from prose but not executable as given; the custom steps (C8 GenBank retrieval, C13 annotation, C14 plotting) are not reconstructable at all.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish an analysis repository (or Zenodo archive) containing the assembly/consensus commands, the BEAUti-generated BEAST XML files for all three phylogenies, the Biopython retrieval script with its query, the variant filtering/annotation script, and the R plotting script.

gaps.missing: No conda environment, lockfile, container image/digest, or requirements file. Version pins exist only for a subset (Guppy v6.4.2, Minimap2 v2.28-r1209 and v2.24, SAMtools v1.14, iVar v1.4.3, BEAST v2.7.7, Tracer v1.7.2, FigTree v1.4.4). cutadapt, Filtlong, Biopython, R and the R packages (ggplot2, tidyverse, ComplexUpset) are unversioned, MAFFT is given as major version 'v7' only, and SAMtools is unversioned at C4 while pinned to v1.14 at C11 (internally inconsistent).
gaps.how_to_close: Ship a pinned environment (conda-lock/pixi.lock) or a container with a recorded digest covering every tool, and resolve the SAMtools/Minimap2 version inconsistency between the assembly and variant-analysis pipelines.

gaps.where: C2, C4, C6, C7, C9, C11 parameters
gaps.missing: No cutadapt command or primer file/adapter definitions; no Minimap2 preset (e.g. -x map-ont) or flags for either mapping step; MAFFT settings for the genotype-assignment alignment unstated ('default settings' only given for the genome alignment); no MCMC seeds, no number of independent chains, no log/sampling frequency, and no operator settings for the BEAST runs; no ESS threshold value reported from Tracer beyond 'convergence and effective sample size were assessed'.
gaps.how_to_close: State exact commands and flags for cutadapt and Minimap2, and deposit the BEAST XML files, which carry the seeds, chain configuration and operator settings.

gaps.where: C6, C8, C9, C10 input sequence sets
gaps.missing: The reference sets are described by count only: DENV-2 genotype I-VI representative references (count unstated), 336 unique complete genotype-II genomes, and 1,132 unique genotype-II E gene sequences. No accession lists, retrieval date, or dereplication criteria ('unique') are provided, so the input sets cannot be regenerated deterministically from a live GenBank.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the exact FASTA input sets (or accession lists with retrieval date and the dereplication rule) and the resulting alignments and tree files.

gaps.missing: Methods for the E-gene analysis are deferred entirely to a Supplementary File ('Detailed methods and the resulting phylogenetic tree are provided in the Supplementary File'); the main-text prose gives no aligner, model, clock, or inference settings for this analysis.
gaps.how_to_close: State the E-gene analysis methods in the main Methods (or confirm they are complete in the supplement) and deposit the corresponding alignment and BEAST XML.

gaps.missing: Wet-lab data-generation steps are out of scope for computational reproduction (OOS); counted in W (3), not verdicted.
